meta.name: Spa-Francorchamps: Grand Prix circuit

elevationSource.title: Relief de la Wallonie - Modèle Numérique de Terrain (MNT) 2021-2022
elevationSource.acquisitionDates: Campaign 2021-02-19 to 2022-03-05; per-tile flight dates vary across the circuit
elevationSource.attribution: © SPW 2021-2022 — Service public de Wallonie (SPW), Relief de la Wallonie - MNT 2021-2022

centerlineSource.url: https://www.openstreetmap.org/ (via Overpass API); © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL

meta.axes: X east, Y up, Z south (Z = -(northing - origin.northing)); metres

widthCorrections.units: [station m, left half-width m, right half-width m] (left/right of travel), linear between knots; elsewhere roadWidthM / 2
widthCorrections.insideCap: inside half-width capped at 70% of the local centreline radius on 9 sections (the road cannot reach the turn centre)
widthCorrections.source: SPW orthophoto ORTHO_2023_ETE (2023-05-27..06-25, 0.65 m/px, CC BY 4.0): edge = white line / kerb inner edge, not the paved run-off beyond
widthCorrections.uncertainty: the knots are photo readings, about +-0.7 m (a dated-image estimate); the final edges are NOT that accurate where the inside cap or smoothing moved them (by up to several metres at the apex): those are geometric approximations
widthCorrections.authoritative: centerline.halfWidth (per sample, after the cap and smoothing) is the road boundary every consumer uses; the knots alone do not reproduce it

meta.heightSmoothing: Centerline height = bilinear DTM sample, then 5-sample (±4 m) moving average along distance. Plan line: OSM nodes resampled at 1 m and smoothed with a ±4 m moving average before resampling at 2 m. Shoulder outer edge = raw bilinear DTM.
notes: Closed loop starting at the Bus Stop chicane exit; the last cross-section joins the first (seam step 2 m in plan, 0.06 m in height).
Road width 12 m is an assumption (FIA minimum for new permanent circuits); the real width varies along the circuit.
DTM read cell-by-cell through the MapServer identify operation (raw 0.5 m cell values); SPW offers no bbox GeoTIFF export.
No bridge decks on this route.
OSM vs bacinger/f1-circuits be-1925 centerline offset: median 0.7 m, p95 2.2 m, max 7.4 m.
Inside shoulder narrowed to 70% of local turn radius on 101 sections (stations 24-44 m, 502-542 m, 592-710 m, 6970-6986 m) so it does not cross itself; 0 triangles fold over in plan view.
